thread:
priya: quick q — can we add a lint check that prevents a flag toggle unless telemetry is wired up? we keep shipping toggles with no perf/quality events :grimacing:
alex: are you thinking compile-time lint (repo) or runtime guard in the console API?
dan: +1 for repo lint. we've caught several bad PRs that way before deploy. repo lint can require a `telemetry_id` field in flag metadata.
jen: console UX needs to surface why toggle is blocked tho. if it's a silent lint error that's annoying for PMs. maybe a soft-block with explainers? :thinking:
priya: prefer two layers: 1) repo lint for PRs 2) console preflight that shows missing telemetry and offers a one-click hookup to link eval/metric.
marco: on the telemetry side we need a standard event name template. otherwise lint will only check presence not quality. propose `feature_flag.{flag_key}.activation` and `feature_flag.{flag_key}.metric`
dan: SGTM. lint rule can regex match event names and/or a mapping file `telemetry_map.yaml`. simple rule: if flag.meta.telemetry_id missing -> fail; if present -> ok.
jen: console preflight could call a new internal API `GET /telemetry/check?telemetry_id=XXX` that returns {ok, suggestions} and show a small banner with the blocker + suggested dashboards to link.
priya: example lint config I'm thinking of (very small):
```yaml
rules:
  - name: require-telemetry-for-flags
    match: /flags/*/metadata.yaml
    require_fields: [telemetry_id]
    telemetry_pattern: '^feature_flag\\.[a-z0-9_]+\\.(activation|metric)$'
```
alex: love the explicit pattern. ops question: what if customers have external telemetry (pager duty, external analytics)? lint would still require an ID — can be a placeholder `external:my-system` and console preflight would just mark it external.
marco: ops-bot: we can extend `telemetry/check` to accept provider field and return a note. ops-bot: automated response: "telemetry provider recognized: segment (external) — no in-console dashboards available"
ops-bot: reaction :white_check_mark: registered default mapping for external providers.
priya: ok, rollout safety idea: if telemetry missing, console switches flag creation to 'pending activation' and requires an explicit confirm with reason (and link to a ticket) before allowing immediate traffic ramp. enforcement level configurable per org.
dan: needs a small policy table: `require_telemetry: [strict|warn|off]` per workspace. default strict for production orgs.
jen: UX note: avoid blocking experiments for small dev work. allow an override checkbox with an audit note that gets attached to flag history. show who overrode and reason.
alex: metrics team: will they need to add the event to our catalog? marco: yes a single whitelist so lint can validate canonicalness. we should also hook to `open-catalog` PR flow to add missing telemetry entries.
priya: next steps: i'll draft a tiny ADR for lint+console preflight, include schema, sample API, and a migration plan (backfill for existing flags). jen can prototype the preflight banner. dan can own lint rule in infra-lint repo. marco will sketch telemetry API contract.
jen: i'll toss a quick mock into figma and link here in a PR comment.
alex: also add alerting: if more than X flags created without telemetry in 24h -> notify eng-platform channel. ops-bot can send that.
ops-bot: scheduled job registered: flag-missing-telemetry-alerts -> posts to #eng-platform with summary daily at 09:00 UTC.
priya: cool. i'll open the ADR later today and tag everyone. thanks :raised_hands:
dan: ack, starting lint draft.
marco: will sketch telemetry contract by EOD.
jen: will demo mock by tomorrow morning.
priya: leaving this thread with action items: ADR, lint PR, telemetry API sketch, console mock. will follow up in PRs.
